review_status: Source-checked by AI; pending local agronomist and native Urdu review

rules.applicability: Global Zea mays screening reference (optimal 5-7, absolute 4.5-8.5) used for a rule-based verdict on the mapped mean; not a locally validated planting recommendation. Compare every available topsoil depth separately. Bounds crossing the reference interval require field testing.
General maize guidance (KALRO) favours well-drained soils; Pakistani extension guidance still to be added. Farmer-reported standing water prompts drainage review, without engineering prescriptions.
General maize guidance (KALRO): check moisture through the soil profile before sowing; cached regional rainfall cannot establish field moisture.

non_agronomic_policy.soil_uncertainty: Flag missing quantiles or a 90% interval crossing either pH reference boundary. No invented width threshold.
non_agronomic_policy.forecast: Require valid interval, issue time <= now, issue age <=48 hours, verified units and source. 48h is a conservative application freshness policy, not a crop threshold.
non_agronomic_policy.other_soil_properties: Stored for context only. No thresholds or fertilizer prescriptions.
